name: opus3_razorqs_confirm_G1_example
comment: EXAMPLE protocol for this pack's runner on holdout G1. It is pinned to this job's c29gat_03 gate build so the dry-run can show the exact command. Before any game, QA must: (1) replace identity.cand_exe with its Code-Reviewed PC build; (2) set training_config_sha256 to the RUN.json config_sha256 of its COMPLETE live tuning run; (3) set the qa_gate names; (4) move the registry to wherever QA keeps it. Each edit changes protocol_sha256, which is intended: a run is bound to the protocol actually played. The runner never plays games: QA plays the dry-run's fastchess command under its own scheduler, then this runner recomputes the decision from that PGN (--mode replay, protocol.replay). The primary route is QA's own runner (CONFIRM_PROTOCOL.md section 3).
training_config_sha256: QA_FILLS_BEFORE_ANY_GAME: RUN.json config_sha256 of the complete live tuning run
sprt_comment: G1 has 2408 openings and each pair uses one, so the cap is 4816 games (2408 pairs); the runner refuses a larger cap unless allow_opening_reuse is set by a written QA decision. At this cap the synthetic power is about that of QA's 5000 (POWER_TABLE.json: P(H1) 0.027 at nElo 5, 0.11 at nElo 10), so G1 decides only large effects. The 40000-game cap needs QA's UHO route (2,632,036 lines).
